title: Lazarus

videos.title: Jesus Raises Lazarus from the Dead

textBlocks:
Miracles of Jesus
Jesus hears that his friend, Lazarus is sick.
But Jesus waits for Lazarus to die before he goes to him.

SO THAT THE MIRACLE WAS AMAZING!
So that people would know that He was the Son of God. That He had power of death.
John 11:45 …many Jews who came to Mary and saw what He did believed in Him
